finding.claim: The /invoice/<inv_id> route has no authentication and no ownership check. Any caller can read any invoice by ID (IDOR). The sibling /my/invoice route does enforce the customer check, which shows the check was intended.
finding.source: inv_id URL path parameter from any unauthenticated or any-user request
finding.sink: jsonify(inv) returns the full invoice record

trace.note: route registered with no auth decorator
INVOICES.get(inv_id) loads the object by request id, with no comparison to g.user

finding.guards_checked: No decorator, no before_request hook, and no g.user comparison in this file. Only one file exists in the repo, so no upstream middleware is visible. The /my/invoice route at line 16 does check ownership, but this route does not.

verdict.reason: invoices.py:7-10 registers /invoice/<inv_id> with no decorator or before_request hook and returns INVOICES.get(inv_id) via jsonify with no g.user comparison, while the sibling route at invoices.py:16 does check ownership; the file is the only one in the repo, so no upstream middleware exists.
